ex.en: I majored in philosophy at my university.
ex.zh: 我在大學主修哲學。

ex.en: Susan is majoring in American history.
ex.zh: 蘇珊主修美國史。

ex.en: What do you plan to major in at college?
ex.zh: 你上大學打算主修什麼？

ex.en: What's your major?
ex.zh: 你主修什麼？

ex.en: My major is economics.
ex.zh: 我主修經濟。

ex.en: Traffic is a major problem in this city.
ex.zh: 交通是這座城市的主要問題。

ex.en: She had major surgery last year.
ex.zh: 她去年動了一場大手術。

ex.en: Don't download files from unknown sites; they may contain malware.
ex.zh: 別從來路不明的網站下載檔案，裡面可能有惡意軟體。

ex.en: Antivirus software can detect most malware.
ex.zh: 防毒軟體可以偵測到大多數惡意軟體。

ex.en: Plastics have taken the place of many conventional materials.
ex.zh: 塑膠已經取代了許多傳統材料。

ex.en: I'm going to go buy some materials today.
ex.zh: 我今天要去買一些材料。

ex.en: She is collecting material for a book.
ex.zh: 她在為一本書蒐集資料。

ex.en: I haven't yet collected sufficient materials to write a book.
ex.zh: 我還沒蒐集到足夠的資料來寫書。

ex.en: Not material, but spiritual things determine our life.
ex.zh: 決定我們生活的不是物質，而是精神。

ex.en: He doesn't care much about material things.
ex.zh: 他不太在乎物質上的東西。

ex.en: Such manuals should be written in simpler language.
ex.zh: 這類說明書應該用更淺顯的文字來寫。

ex.en: If only I read the user manual properly.
ex.zh: 要是我當初有好好看使用手冊就好了。

ex.en: She was reading a gardening manual.
ex.zh: 她正在看一本園藝手冊。

ex.en: Can you drive a manual transmission?
ex.zh: 你會開手排車嗎？

ex.en: I'm unable to do manual labour.
ex.zh: 我沒辦法做體力活。

ex.en: The system still requires a lot of manual data entry.
ex.zh: 這個系統仍需要大量手動輸入資料。

ex.en: I'd like to go to the mall.
ex.zh: 我想去購物中心。

ex.en: This shopping mall is one mile ahead.
ex.zh: 這間購物中心就在前方一英里處。

ex.en: Is there a mall near here?
ex.zh: 這附近有購物中心嗎？

ex.en: The man wore a mask of a tiger.
ex.zh: 那個男人戴著老虎面具。

ex.en: He wore a mask so that no one could recognize him.
ex.zh: 他戴著面具，所以沒人認得出他。

ex.en: Tom took off his mask.
ex.zh: 湯姆把口罩拿下來了。

ex.en: Please wear a mask on the bus.
ex.zh: 搭公車時請戴口罩。

ex.en: She tried to mask her disappointment.
ex.zh: 她試著掩飾自己的失望。

ex.en: The air freshener masked the smell.
ex.zh: 芳香劑蓋過了那股味道。

ex.en: My classmate, Xiao Ming, has strong managerial capability.
ex.zh: 我同學小明的管理能力很強。

ex.en: She has ten years of managerial experience.
ex.zh: 她有十年的管理經驗。

ex.en: He was promoted to a managerial position.
ex.zh: 他被升為管理職。

ex.en: I want a massage. I need to relax.
ex.zh: 我想去按摩，我需要放鬆一下。

ex.en: She gave him a massage.
ex.zh: 她幫他按摩。

ex.en: She works as a massage therapist.
ex.zh: 她是按摩師。

ex.en: Gently massage the cream into your skin.
ex.zh: 把乳霜輕輕按摩到皮膚裡。

ex.en: My neck hurts. Can you massage it for me?
ex.zh: 我脖子好痠，可以幫我按摩一下嗎？

ex.en: We need to maximize profits this year.
ex.zh: 我們今年需要讓獲利最大化。

ex.en: The new layout maximizes the use of space.
ex.zh: 新的配置讓空間得到最充分的利用。

ex.en: Click here to maximize the window.
ex.zh: 點這裡把視窗放到最大。

ex.en: Maximize the browser so you can see the whole page.
ex.zh: 把瀏覽器放到最大，才能看到整個頁面。

ma'am.zh: 女士、小姐（對女性的尊稱）

ex.en: Excuse me, ma'am, you dropped your wallet.
ex.zh: 女士，不好意思，您的錢包掉了。

ex.en: Can I help you, ma'am?
ex.zh: 女士，有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

ex.en: She showed great maturity for her age.
ex.zh: 以她的年紀來說，她非常成熟。

ex.en: Emotional maturity is important for leaders.
ex.zh: 情緒成熟對領導者很重要。

ex.en: The bond reaches maturity in five years.
ex.zh: 這張債券五年後到期。

ex.en: You will receive the full amount at maturity.
ex.zh: 到期時你會拿到全額。

ex.en: There is only a marginal difference between the two.
ex.zh: 兩者之間只有些微的差異。

ex.en: The new policy had only a marginal effect on sales.
ex.zh: 新政策對銷售只有些微的影響。

ex.en: Profits saw a marginal increase this year.
ex.zh: 今年利潤略有增加。

marketer.zh: 行銷人員；（產品的）銷售商

ex.en: Marketers use social media to reach young customers.
ex.zh: 行銷人員利用社群媒體接觸年輕顧客。

ex.en: She works as a digital marketer for a tech firm.
ex.zh: 她在一家科技公司擔任數位行銷人員。

matrix.zh: 矩陣；（組織的）矩陣式結構

ex.en: We use a decision matrix to compare the options.
ex.zh: 我們用決策矩陣來比較各個選項。

ex.en: The company has a matrix structure with two bosses.
ex.zh: 這家公司採矩陣式結構，有兩位主管。

ex.en: The company must compete in a global marketplace.
ex.zh: 公司必須在全球市場上競爭。

ex.en: I sold my old bike on an online marketplace.
ex.zh: 我在網路交易平台賣掉了舊腳踏車。

ex.en: The government has a mandate to reform taxes.
ex.zh: 政府獲得民意授權改革稅制。

ex.en: The committee's mandate is to review safety rules.
ex.zh: 委員會的任務是檢討安全規定。

ex.en: The law mandates safety training for all staff.
ex.zh: 法律規定所有員工都要受安全訓練。

ex.en: Masks were mandated on public transport.
ex.zh: 大眾運輸上曾強制戴口罩。

ex.en: Macroeconomic conditions affect consumer spending.
ex.zh: 總體經濟情勢會影響消費支出。

ex.en: The bank publishes a macroeconomic report every quarter.
ex.zh: 這家銀行每季發表總體經濟報告。

ex.en: He is good at solving complicated mathematical problems.
ex.zh: 他擅長解複雜的數學題。

ex.en: Einstein was a mathematical genius.
ex.zh: 愛因斯坦是數學天才。

ex.en: Electric cars are entering the mainstream.
ex.zh: 電動車正逐漸成為主流。

ex.en: His ideas are far from the mainstream.
ex.zh: 他的想法跟主流相去甚遠。

ex.en: Mainstream media did not report the story.
ex.zh: 主流媒體沒有報導這件事。

ex.en: The band became popular with mainstream audiences.
ex.zh: 這個樂團受到一般大眾歡迎。

ex.en: We didn't realize the magnitude of the problem.
ex.zh: 我們當時沒意識到問題有多嚴重。

ex.en: Nobody expected a project of this magnitude.
ex.zh: 沒有人料到會有這麼大規模的專案。

ex.en: A massive earthquake of magnitude 8.8 hit the Japanese islands today.
ex.zh: 今天，一場規模 8.8 的強烈地震襲擊了日本列島。

ex.en: The earthquake had a magnitude of 6.5.
ex.zh: 這次地震規模為 6.5。

ex.en: I'm taking a course in macroeconomics this semester.
ex.zh: 我這學期修了一門總體經濟學。

ex.en: Macroeconomics studies inflation, growth, and unemployment.
ex.zh: 總體經濟學研究通膨、成長和失業。

ex.en: The new rules will not materially affect our business.
ex.zh: 新規定不會對我們的業務造成實質影響。

ex.en: The results did not change materially.
ex.zh: 結果並沒有重大改變。

ex.en: They are materially comfortable but not happy.
ex.zh: 他們物質生活優渥，卻不快樂。

ex.en: Materially, we have everything we need.
ex.zh: 在物質上，我們什麼都不缺。

ex.en: He tried to manipulate the data to look better.
ex.zh: 他試圖操弄數據讓結果好看一點。

ex.en: Don't let anyone manipulate you.
ex.zh: 不要讓任何人操控你。

ex.en: This software lets you manipulate images easily.
ex.zh: 這套軟體讓你能輕鬆編修影像。

ex.en: Robots can manipulate small parts with great precision.
ex.zh: 機器人能非常精準地操作小零件。

ex.en: The ferry runs between the island and the mainland.
ex.zh: 渡輪往返於島嶼和本土之間。

ex.en: Prices on the island are higher than on the mainland.
ex.zh: 島上的物價比本土高。

ex.en: Profit maximization is the main goal of the firm.
ex.zh: 利潤最大化是這家公司的主要目標。

ex.en: The strategy focuses on revenue maximization.
ex.zh: 這項策略著重於營收最大化。

ex.en: Macro factors such as interest rates affect our sales.
ex.zh: 利率等總體因素會影響我們的銷售。

ex.en: Let's look at the macro picture before the details.
ex.zh: 我們先看整體大局，再看細節。

ex.en: I wrote a macro to create the report automatically.
ex.zh: 我寫了一個巨集來自動產生報表。

ex.en: Excel macros can save you a lot of time.
ex.zh: Excel 巨集可以幫你省下很多時間。

ex.en: Fluency in English is a very marketable skill today.
ex.zh: 英文流利是現今非常搶手的技能。

ex.en: We need to make the product more marketable.
ex.zh: 我們需要讓這個產品更有市場。

ex.en: The report accused the company of price manipulation.
ex.zh: 報告指控這家公司操縱價格。

ex.en: Emotional manipulation can damage a relationship.
ex.zh: 情緒操控會傷害一段關係。

ex.en: This tool makes data manipulation much easier.
ex.zh: 這個工具讓資料處理容易得多。

ex.en: Image manipulation software is easy to use now.
ex.zh: 現在的修圖軟體很容易上手。

ex.en: Bad weather marred the opening ceremony.
ex.zh: 惡劣的天氣破壞了開幕典禮。

ex.en: One small mistake marred an otherwise perfect report.
ex.zh: 一個小錯誤讓原本完美的報告美中不足。

maneuver.zh: （巧妙的）動作、操作法；策略、手段

ex.en: Do you know the Heimlich maneuver?
ex.zh: 你知道哈姆立克急救法嗎？

ex.en: Hiring her away was a smart business maneuver.
ex.zh: 把她挖角過來是很聰明的商業手段。

ex.en: Sami didn't have time to maneuver.
ex.zh: 薩米來不及閃避。

ex.en: It was hard to maneuver the car into the tiny parking space.
ex.zh: 要把車開進那個小車位很難。

ex.en: Magnetic fields are invisible.
ex.zh: 磁場是看不見的。

ex.en: Keep the magnetic card away from your phone.
ex.zh: 磁卡要遠離手機。

ex.en: She has a magnetic personality.
ex.zh: 她的個性很有魅力。

ex.en: The singer's magnetic stage presence won over the crowd.
ex.zh: 這位歌手極具魅力的台風征服了觀眾。

ex.en: Nothing is so tasty as the dish you make.
ex.zh: 沒有什麼比你做的菜更好吃了。

ex.en: I'll make some coffee.
ex.zh: 我來泡點咖啡。

ex.en: You must be careful not to make him angry.
ex.zh: 你要小心，別惹他生氣。

ex.en: The mere thought of a snake makes me shiver.
ex.zh: 一想到蛇我就發抖。

ex.en: You continue making the same mistakes time after time.
ex.zh: 你一再犯同樣的錯誤。

ex.en: We need to make a decision today.
ex.zh: 我們今天必須做出決定。

ex.en: She makes about 5,000 dollars a month.
ex.zh: 她一個月大約賺五千美元。

ex.en: The company made a profit last year.
ex.zh: 公司去年有獲利。

make.zh: make it：及時趕到；能出席；成功

ex.en: We made it to the airport just in time.
ex.zh: 我們及時趕到了機場。

ex.en: Can you make it to the meeting at three?
ex.zh: 你三點能來開會嗎？

ex.en: I may have left my umbrella in the bus.
ex.zh: 我可能把雨傘忘在公車上了。

ex.en: This story may sound strange, but it's absolutely true.
ex.zh: 這個故事聽起來可能很奇怪，但卻是千真萬確的。

ex.en: Take your time, or you may make some mistakes.
ex.zh: 慢慢來，不然你可能會出錯。

ex.en: You may stay here as long as you like.
ex.zh: 你想在這裡待多久都可以。

ex.en: May I come in?
ex.zh: 我可以進來嗎？

ex.en: You may as well tell me all about it.
ex.zh: 你不妨把事情全部告訴我。

ex.en: We may as well start now.
ex.zh: 我們不如現在就開始。

ex.en: My birthday is in May.
ex.zh: 我的生日在五月。

ex.en: The conference will be held in May.
ex.zh: 研討會將在五月舉行。

ex.en: Science has brought about many changes to our lives.
ex.zh: 科學為我們的生活帶來了許多改變。

ex.en: I am happy to have so many good friends.
ex.zh: 我很高興有這麼多好朋友。

ex.en: English is spoken in many parts of the world.
ex.zh: 世界上許多地方都說英語。

ex.en: Many of my friends live abroad.
ex.zh: 我很多朋友住在國外。

ex.en: Many believe the price will go up.
ex.zh: 許多人認為價格會上漲。

ex.en: How many schools are there in your city?
ex.zh: 你們城市有幾所學校？

ex.en: How many people work here?
ex.zh: 這裡有多少人工作？

ex.en: Generally speaking, men can run faster than women can.
ex.zh: 一般來說，男人跑得比女人快。

ex.en: We lost sight of the man in the crowd.
ex.zh: 我們在人群中跟丟了那個男人。

ex.en: Mary doesn't like men who are stingy like Tom.
ex.zh: 瑪莉不喜歡像湯姆那樣小氣的男人。

ex.en: England expects that every man will do his duty.
ex.zh: 英國期望每個人都盡到自己的責任。

ex.en: Man is the only animal that uses fire.
ex.zh: 人類是唯一會使用火的動物。

ex.en: The booth is manned by two staff members.
ex.zh: 這個攤位由兩名工作人員負責。

ex.en: Who will man the front desk tomorrow?
ex.zh: 明天誰要顧櫃台？

ex.en: I don't want to be involved in that matter.
ex.zh: 我不想被捲入那件事。

ex.en: Don't interfere with matters that do not concern you!
ex.zh: 不要干涉與你無關的事！

ex.en: Even if it is true, it matters little.
ex.zh: 就算是真的，也沒什麼關係。

ex.en: It doesn't matter what other people think.
ex.zh: 別人怎麼想並不重要。

ex.en: No matter what happens, you must not give up.
ex.zh: 無論發生什麼事，你都不能放棄。

ex.en: No matter what happens, I won't change my mind.
ex.zh: 無論發生什麼事，我都不會改變主意。

ex.en: What's the matter with your computer?
ex.zh: 你的電腦怎麼了？

ex.en: What's the matter? You look tired.
ex.zh: 怎麼了？你看起來很累。

ex.en: His main object in life was to become rich.
ex.zh: 他人生的主要目標就是變有錢。

ex.en: One of the main products of this country is coffee.
ex.zh: 咖啡是這個國家的主要產品之一。

ex.en: The main entrance is on the left side of the building.
ex.zh: 大樓的主要入口在左側。

ex.en: The water mains burst due to the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震震破了自來水總管。

ex.en: Workers are repairing a broken gas main.
ex.zh: 工人正在修理破裂的瓦斯總管。

ex.en: My head hurts. Maybe I should take an aspirin.
ex.zh: 我頭痛，也許該吃顆阿斯匹靈。

ex.en: Maybe we can buy Tom a new one.
ex.zh: 也許我們可以買個新的給湯姆。

ex.en: Maybe I should just tell Tom the truth.
ex.zh: 也許我就該直接跟湯姆說實話。

ex.en: She managed to finish the work on her own.
ex.zh: 她設法靠自己完成了工作。

ex.en: We managed to get it back without her knowing.
ex.zh: 我們設法在她不知情的情況下把它拿回來。

ex.en: How do people manage to sleep on the plane?
ex.zh: 人們是怎麼在飛機上睡得著的？

ex.en: He doesn't have the ability to manage that group.
ex.zh: 他沒有能力管理那個團隊。

ex.en: She manages a small restaurant.
ex.zh: 她經營一家小餐廳。

ex.en: He is good at managing his time.
ex.zh: 他很擅長管理時間。

ex.en: Management of a company is different from ownership of a company.
ex.zh: 經營一家公司和擁有一家公司是兩回事。

ex.en: Sami doesn't know anything about management.
ex.zh: 薩米對管理一竅不通。

ex.en: The company is starting to implement the new management system from next month.
ex.zh: 公司下個月開始實施新的管理制度。

ex.en: Japanese management must learn how to deal with American workers, he said.
ex.zh: 他說：「日本管理階層必須學會如何對待美國員工。」

ex.en: Management has approved the new budget.
ex.zh: 管理階層已核准新預算。

ex.en: Almost no students get full marks in Chinese classics.
ex.zh: 幾乎沒有學生在古文考試拿到滿分。

ex.en: It is true that he got full marks on the test.
ex.zh: 他考試拿了滿分是真的。

ex.en: The wet vase left a mark on the table.
ex.zh: 濕花瓶在桌上留下了水痕。

ex.en: Put a mark next to the correct answer.
ex.zh: 在正確答案旁做個記號。

ex.en: I marked the important parts in red.
ex.zh: 我用紅色標出重要的部分。

ex.en: Please mark the box if you agree.
ex.zh: 如果同意，請在方框中打勾。

ex.en: The invention of the transistor marked a new era.
ex.zh: 電晶體的發明開創了一個新時代。

ex.en: The event marks the company's 50th anniversary.
ex.zh: 這場活動是為了紀念公司成立五十週年。

ex.en: The engineer told us how to use the machine.
ex.zh: 工程師告訴我們怎麼使用這台機器。

ex.en: This machine is too heavy for me to carry.
ex.zh: 這台機器太重，我搬不動。

ex.en: The vending machines are over there.
ex.zh: 自動販賣機在那邊。

ex.en: I have three dogs. One is male and the other two are female.
ex.zh: 我養了三隻狗，一隻是公的，另外兩隻是母的。

ex.en: Every male Algerian citizen must do military service.
ex.zh: 每個阿爾及利亞男性公民都必須服兵役。

ex.en: Most of the male employees wear suits.
ex.zh: 大部分男性員工都穿西裝。

ex.en: Why are there differences between males and females?
ex.zh: 為什麼男性和女性之間會有差異？

ex.en: The male of this bird has bright feathers.
ex.zh: 這種鳥的雄鳥羽毛很鮮豔。

ex.en: It is hard to maintain one's reputation.
ex.zh: 要維持一個人的名聲很難。

ex.en: We need to maintain high quality standards.
ex.zh: 我們需要維持高品質標準。

ex.en: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
ex.zh: 雷射印表機的維護成本通常比噴墨印表機低。

ex.en: The building is well maintained.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓維護得很好。

ex.en: She maintains that her analysis is correct.
ex.zh: 她堅稱自己的分析是正確的。

ex.en: Tom maintained his innocence.
ex.zh: 湯姆堅稱自己是無辜的。

ex.en: Can I have a look at the magazine?
ex.zh: 我可以看一下那本雜誌嗎？

ex.en: Are there any English magazines in this library?
ex.zh: 這間圖書館有英文雜誌嗎？

ex.en: Such magazines have a great influence on children.
ex.zh: 這類雜誌對小孩的影響很大。

ex.en: The majority of people marry sooner or later.
ex.zh: 大部分的人遲早會結婚。

ex.en: The majority of his clientele are poor people.
ex.zh: 他的客戶大多是窮人。

ex.en: The majority of our customers are young people.
ex.zh: 我們大多數的顧客都是年輕人。

ex.en: The bill passed by a small majority of 10 votes.
ex.zh: 這項法案以十票的些微多數通過。

ex.en: The plan was approved by a large majority.
ex.zh: 這個計畫以壓倒性多數通過。

mass.zh: 大量的、大規模的、大眾的

ex.en: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
ex.zh: 大量生產降低了許多商品的價格。

ex.en: This famous mountain climber is a critic of mass tourism.
ex.zh: 這位知名登山家批評大眾觀光。

ex.en: Their small protest triggered a mass demonstration.
ex.zh: 他們的小型抗議引發了一場大規模示威。

ex.en: There is a mass of dark clouds in the sky.
ex.zh: 天空有一大片烏雲。

ex.en: A cloud is a mass of vapor in the sky.
ex.zh: 雲是天空中的一團水氣。

ex.en: Marriage has many pains, but celibacy has no pleasures.
ex.zh: 婚姻有許多痛苦，但單身沒有任何樂趣。

ex.en: She is dependent on her parents even after her marriage.
ex.zh: 她婚後仍然依賴父母。

ex.en: They have a happy marriage.
ex.zh: 他們的婚姻很幸福。

ex.en: I'm surprised that you don't know about their marriage.
ex.zh: 我很驚訝你竟然不知道他們結婚了。

ex.en: Their marriage took place in a small church.
ex.zh: 他們在一間小教堂結婚。

ex.en: The bat's diet consists mainly of insects and fruit.
ex.zh: 蝙蝠主要吃昆蟲和水果。

ex.en: That company deals mainly in imported goods.
ex.zh: 這家公司主要經營進口商品。

ex.en: Our customers are mainly young people.
ex.zh: 我們的顧客主要是年輕人。

ex.en: George did business in the same manner as his father.
ex.zh: 喬治做生意的方式跟他父親一樣。

ex.en: I don't like his affected manner of speaking.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡他做作的說話方式。

ex.en: I have trouble putting up with his rude manner.
ex.zh: 我受不了他那種無禮的態度。

ex.en: She has a friendly manner with customers.
ex.zh: 她對顧客態度親切。

ex.en: It is bad manners to point at people.
ex.zh: 用手指指人很沒禮貌。

ex.en: It's not good manners speaking during the meal.
ex.zh: 吃飯時講話不太禮貌。

ex.en: English will take you a long time to master.
ex.zh: 你需要花很長的時間才能精通英語。

ex.en: A foreign language cannot be mastered in a year or so.
ex.zh: 一門外語不可能在一年左右就學好。

ex.en: Mastering a foreign language calls for patience.
ex.zh: 精通一門外語需要耐心。

ex.en: People should be the masters of their own destinies.
ex.zh: 每個人都應該做自己命運的主人。

ex.en: He is a master of Chinese calligraphy.
ex.zh: 他是書法大師。

ex.en: She has a master's degree in finance.
ex.zh: 她有財務金融碩士學位。

ex.en: He's doing a master's in engineering.
ex.zh: 他正在攻讀工程碩士。

master.zh: 主要的；原版的（master bedroom 主臥室）

ex.en: I keep the master copy under lock and key.
ex.zh: 我把母片鎖起來妥善保管。

ex.en: The master bedroom has its own bathroom.
ex.zh: 主臥室有獨立衛浴。

ex.en: Please mail this form to your insurance company.
ex.zh: 請把這份表格寄給你的保險公司。

ex.en: Would you mind mailing this letter for me?
ex.zh: 可以幫我寄這封信嗎？

ex.en: Please remind me to mail the report tomorrow.
ex.zh: 請提醒我明天把報告寄出去。

ex.en: Has the mail arrived yet?
ex.zh: 郵件送來了嗎？

ex.en: I'll send the contract by mail.
ex.zh: 我會用郵寄的方式寄出合約。

ex.en: This truck has a maximum load of 5 tons.
ex.zh: 這輛卡車的最大載重量是五噸。

ex.en: The maximum speed on this road is 50 kilometers per hour.
ex.zh: 這條路的最高速限是時速 50 公里。

maximum.zh: 最大量、最大限度；最大值

ex.en: Note that the maximum doesn't always exist.
ex.zh: 注意，最大值不一定存在。

ex.en: The room holds a maximum of 30 people.
ex.zh: 這個房間最多可容納 30 人。

ex.en: Please contact the manufacturer for repairs.
ex.zh: 維修請聯絡製造商。

ex.en: The company is a leading manufacturer of electronic parts.
ex.zh: 這家公司是電子零件的主要製造商。

ex.en: Follow the manufacturer's instructions carefully.
ex.zh: 請仔細遵照製造商的使用說明。

ex.en: This is the most massive structure I have ever seen.
ex.zh: 這是我見過最龐大的建築物。

ex.en: Hey, look! Look! There's a massive rainbow!
ex.zh: 嘿，快看！有一道好大的彩虹！

ex.en: The company is facing massive losses this year.
ex.zh: 公司今年面臨巨額虧損。

ex.en: We had an examination in mathematics today.
ex.zh: 我們今天考了數學。

ex.en: I do not like mathematics very much.
ex.zh: 我不太喜歡數學。

ex.en: Maria asked me to help her in mathematics.
ex.zh: 瑪麗亞請我幫她學數學。

ex.en: He grew a beard to look more mature.
ex.zh: 他留鬍子，好讓自己看起來更成熟。

ex.en: She is very mature for her age.
ex.zh: 以她的年紀來說，她非常成熟。

ex.en: Wine is put in barrels to mature.
ex.zh: 葡萄酒會放在木桶裡熟成。

ex.en: Children mature at different rates.
ex.zh: 每個孩子成熟的速度不同。

ex.en: The bond matures in five years.
ex.zh: 這張債券五年後到期。

ex.en: My insurance policy matures next year.
ex.zh: 我的保單明年到期。

mate.zh: 夥伴、同伴（常用於 classmate、roommate 等）

ex.en: I cannot understand my school mate's Cantonese.
ex.zh: 我聽不懂同學說的廣東話。

ex.en: I'm Paul, your room mate.
ex.zh: 我是保羅，你的室友。

ex.en: After my work mate quit his job he moved to Shanghai to teach English.
ex.zh: 我同事辭職後搬到上海教英文。

ex.en: I don't even know what you are called, mate.
ex.zh: 老兄，我連你叫什麼都不知道。

ex.en: Thanks for your help, mate!
ex.zh: 謝謝你的幫忙，兄弟！

ex.en: During mating season many animals exude strong fragrances.
ex.zh: 很多動物在交配季節會散發強烈的氣味。

ex.en: Many birds mate for life.
ex.zh: 許多鳥類一生只有一個伴侶。

ex.en: Write your notes in the margin.
ex.zh: 把筆記寫在頁邊空白處。

ex.en: Leave a wide margin on each side of the page.
ex.zh: 頁面兩側要留寬一點的邊。

ex.en: She won the election by a narrow margin.
ex.zh: 她以些微差距贏得選舉。

ex.en: We won the game by a margin of ten points.
ex.zh: 我們以十分之差贏得比賽。

ex.en: Our profit margins are getting smaller.
ex.zh: 我們的利潤率越來越低。

ex.en: The store sells its goods at a low margin.
ex.zh: 這家店以低毛利銷售商品。

ex.en: I didn't think that Tom would be so mad.
ex.zh: 我沒有想到湯姆會那麼生氣。

ex.en: Please don't get mad, sir! I'm a new worker!
ex.zh: 先生，請別生氣！我是新來的員工！

ex.en: He got mad at me for calling him Shorty.
ex.zh: 我叫他「矮子」，他氣得要命。

ex.en: For a moment there, I thought he had gone mad.
ex.zh: 那一瞬間，我還以為他瘋了。

ex.en: He went mad when he heard the story.
ex.zh: 他聽到那件事後簡直要瘋了。

ex.en: My son is mad about soccer.
ex.zh: 我兒子超迷足球。

ex.en: She's mad about Korean dramas.
ex.zh: 她非常著迷韓劇。

ex.en: March 15 will be my last day of school.
ex.zh: 3 月 15 日將是我最後一天上學。

ex.en: All the flights on March 30th were fully booked.
ex.zh: 3 月 30 日的班機全部客滿。

ex.en: A brass band is marching along the street.
ex.zh: 一支銅管樂隊沿著街道行進。

ex.en: The band marched in the parade.
ex.zh: 樂隊在遊行隊伍中行進。

ex.en: We joined a charity march last weekend.
ex.zh: 我們上週末參加了一場慈善健走遊行。

ex.en: The soldiers were tired after the long march.
ex.zh: 士兵們長途行軍後很疲累。

ex.en: Sami tried some easy magic tricks.
ex.zh: 薩米試著變了幾個簡單的魔術。

ex.en: The girl vanished like magic.
ex.zh: 那個女孩像變魔術一樣消失了。

ex.en: The kids loved the magic show.
ex.zh: 孩子們很喜歡那場魔術表演。

ex.en: My parents say that YouTube and streaming services cheapen the magic of film.
ex.zh: 我爸媽說 YouTube 和串流平台讓電影失去了魔力。

ex.en: The magic of Paris attracts millions of visitors.
ex.zh: 巴黎的魅力吸引了數百萬遊客。

ex.en: There's no magic solution to this problem.
ex.zh: 這個問題沒有神奇的解決辦法。

ex.en: Please is a magic word for kids.
ex.zh: 對小孩來說，「請」是個神奇的字。

ex.en: Toyota is a major car maker.
ex.zh: 豐田是一家大型汽車製造商。

ex.en: The maker recalled the faulty phones.
ex.zh: 製造商回收了那批有問題的手機。

ex.en: Grease the waffle maker.
ex.zh: 在鬆餅機上抹油。

ex.en: I bought a new coffee maker for the office.
ex.zh: 我幫辦公室買了一台新的咖啡機。

ex.en: He is one of the candidates running for mayor.
ex.zh: 他是市長候選人之一。

ex.en: He was elected mayor of the city.
ex.zh: 他當選了市長。

ex.en: He is going to run for mayor.
ex.zh: 他將參選市長。

ex.en: He showed me the manuscript of his new play.
ex.zh: 他給我看了他新劇本的手稿。

ex.en: The author sent her manuscript to three publishers.
ex.zh: 作者把她的稿子寄給三家出版社。

ex.en: Please check the manuscript for errors before printing.
ex.zh: 印刷前請檢查原稿有沒有錯誤。

ex.en: Thousands of laborers and craftsmen toiled for 22 years to craft the stunning white marble edifice.
ex.zh: 數千名工人與工匠辛苦工作了 22 年，才打造出這座令人驚嘆的白色大理石建築。

ex.en: The hotel lobby has a marble floor.
ex.zh: 飯店大廳鋪著大理石地板。

ex.en: The kids were playing marbles in the yard.
ex.zh: 孩子們在院子裡玩彈珠。

ex.en: He keeps his marbles in a glass jar.
ex.zh: 他把彈珠放在玻璃罐裡。

ex.en: Write your name with a marker.
ex.zh: 用麥克筆寫上你的名字。

ex.en: Please use a whiteboard marker, not a pen.
ex.zh: 請用白板筆，不要用原子筆。

ex.en: A stone marker shows where the old gate stood.
ex.zh: 一塊石碑標示出舊城門的位置。

ex.en: Blood pressure is an important marker of health.
ex.zh: 血壓是重要的健康指標。

ex.en: He received a bone marrow transplant.
ex.zh: 他接受了骨髓移植。

ex.en: She signed up to be a bone marrow donor.
ex.zh: 她登記成為骨髓捐贈者。

ex.en: Maternal love is greater than anything else.
ex.zh: 母愛比什麼都偉大。

ex.en: She has strong maternal instincts.
ex.zh: 她有很強的母性本能。

maternal.zh: 母系的、母方的（外公、外婆等）

ex.en: My mother's father is my maternal grandfather.
ex.zh: 我媽媽的爸爸是我的外公。

ex.en: My maternal grandmother lives in Tainan.
ex.zh: 我外婆住在台南。

ex.en: He asked her to marry him, and she accepted.
ex.zh: 他向她求婚，她答應了。

ex.en: It is already ten years since we got married.
ex.zh: 我們結婚已經有十年了。

ex.en: Mariko's parents are strongly opposed to her marrying an American.
ex.zh: 麻理子的父母強烈反對她和美國人結婚。

ex.en: There are big markdowns on winter coats this week.
ex.zh: 這週冬季外套大降價。

ex.en: The store announced a 30% markdown on all shoes.
ex.zh: 這家店宣布所有鞋子降價三成。

ex.en: For the main course, I'll have the steak.
ex.zh: 主菜我要牛排。

ex.en: The main course was served with rice and vegetables.
ex.zh: 主菜附米飯和蔬菜。

ex.en: We watched the tennis match on TV.
ex.zh: 我們在電視上看網球比賽。

ex.en: Our team won the match 3 to 1.
ex.zh: 我們隊以三比一贏了比賽。

ex.en: Ben learned to make a fire without matches.
ex.zh: 班學會了不用火柴生火。

ex.en: Do you have a match? I need to light the candle.
ex.zh: 你有火柴嗎？我要點蠟燭。

ex.en: Mr. and Mrs. Smith are a good match.
ex.zh: 史密斯夫婦是很登對的一對。

ex.en: He is a good match for me in tennis.
ex.zh: 打網球的話，他和我勢均力敵。

ex.en: The restaurant can't be matched for good service.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳的服務無人能比。

ex.en: Your shoes don't match your dress.
ex.zh: 你的鞋子跟洋裝不搭。

ex.en: This really is a masterpiece.
ex.zh: 這真是個傑作。

ex.en: “The Satanic Verses” by Salman Rushdie is a real masterpiece of modern literature.
ex.zh: 魯西迪的《魔鬼詩篇》是現代文學的傑作。

ex.en: He was surprised to find the great artist's masterpiece hung on the wall upside down.
ex.zh: 他驚訝地發現，那位大畫家的傑作竟然被倒掛在牆上。

ex.en: An old worker was found repairing machinery in the workshop.
ex.zh: 有人看到一位老工人在車間裡修理機器。

ex.en: Something must be wrong with the machinery.
ex.zh: 機器一定是哪裡出了問題。

ex.en: Then arose the question of where we were to get the necessary machinery.
ex.zh: 接著問題來了：我們要去哪裡弄到需要的機器？

ex.en: This company manufactures computer chips.
ex.zh: 這家公司生產電腦晶片。

ex.en: This factory manufactures automobile parts.
ex.zh: 這家工廠生產汽車零件。

ex.en: These cameras are manufactured in Japan.
ex.zh: 這些相機是在日本製造的。

ex.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.
ex.zh: 製造日期印在蓋子上。

ex.en: We are planning changes to the manufacturing process.
ex.zh: 我們打算改變製造流程。

ex.en: We bought some vegetables and fish at the market.
ex.zh: 我們在市場買了一些菜和魚。

ex.en: Can you tell me where the flea market is?
ex.zh: 你能告訴我跳蚤市場在哪裡嗎？

ex.en: The company wants to enter the Japanese market.
ex.zh: 這家公司想打進日本市場。

ex.en: There is a big market for electric cars.
ex.zh: 電動車有很大的市場。

ex.en: The product is marketed to young people.
ex.zh: 這項產品主打年輕族群。

ex.en: They market their tea online.
ex.zh: 他們在網路上行銷自家的茶。

ex.en: The company increased its market share to 30%.
ex.zh: 這家公司把市占率提高到 30%。

ex.en: We are losing market share to cheaper brands.
ex.zh: 我們的市占率正被更便宜的品牌搶走。

ex.en: That isn't mandatory.
ex.zh: 那不是強制的。

ex.en: A cooking course should be mandatory in schools.
ex.zh: 烹飪課應該成為學校的必修課。

ex.en: Wearing a helmet is mandatory on construction sites.
ex.zh: 在工地戴安全帽是強制規定。

ex.en: The elevator is closed for maintenance.
ex.zh: 電梯維修中，暫停使用。

ex.en: Regular maintenance keeps your car running well.
ex.zh: 定期保養能讓你的車保持良好狀態。

ex.en: The repair for the system malfunction lasted for an entire night.
ex.zh: 系統故障的修復工作持續了一整夜。

ex.en: A malfunction in the engine caused the delay.
ex.zh: 引擎故障導致延誤。

ex.en: This clock seems to be malfunctioning.
ex.zh: 這個時鐘好像故障了。

ex.en: The alarm malfunctioned and went off at midnight.
ex.zh: 警報器故障，半夜響了起來。

ex.en: The package is waiting in the mailroom.
ex.zh: 包裹正在郵件收發室等候領取。

ex.en: Mailroom staff sort incoming letters each morning.
ex.zh: 郵件收發室人員每天早上分類收到的信件。

ex.en: The signed agreement is in your mailbox.
ex.zh: 已簽署的協議在您的信箱裡。

ex.en: Please check the mailbox for the client letter.
ex.zh: 請查看信箱裡的客戶來信。

ex.en: She will begin maternity leave in September.
ex.zh: 她將於九月開始休產假。

ex.en: The company offers paid maternity leave.
ex.zh: 公司提供有薪產假。

ex.en: The warehouse needs extra manpower during the holiday rush.
ex.zh: 假期旺季期間，倉庫需要增加人力。

ex.en: A shortage of trained manpower delayed the equipment installation.
ex.zh: 熟練人力不足，導致設備安裝延後。

market penetration.zh: 市場滲透；市場占有率拓展

ex.en: A local distributor helped the brand increase its market penetration in central Taiwan.
ex.zh: 當地經銷商協助這個品牌拓展在台灣中部的市場滲透率。

ex.en: The report compares the product’s market penetration across three age groups.
ex.zh: 這份報告比較該產品在三個年齡層中的市場滲透情況。

markup.zh: 加價幅度；（售價高於成本的）加價

ex.en: The retailer added a 15% markup to the wholesale price.
ex.zh: 零售商在批發價上加了 15% 作為加價。

ex.en: A high markup may discourage budget-conscious buyers.
ex.zh: 加價幅度太高，可能會讓重視預算的買家卻步。

ex.en: The customs officer reviewed the cargo manifest.
ex.zh: 海關人員檢查了貨物清單。

ex.en: Each package must appear on the shipping manifest.
ex.zh: 每個包裹都必須列在運送清單上。

ex.en: The port follows strict maritime safety rules.
ex.zh: 這座港口遵守嚴格的海事安全規範。

ex.en: Maritime transport carries most of the company's exports.
ex.zh: 公司的大部分出口貨物都由海運承載。

ex.en: The historic mansion now operates as a public museum.
ex.zh: 這座歷史豪宅現在作為公立博物館使用。

ex.en: The developer converted the mansion into a boutique hotel.
ex.zh: 開發商將這棟大宅邸改建成精品旅館。

ex.en: The new collection is displayed on mannequins by the entrance.
ex.zh: 入口旁的人體模型展示了新系列服裝。

ex.en: A mannequin in the window wears the store"s latest coat.
ex.zh: 櫥窗裡的服裝模特兒穿著店內最新款的大衣。

ex.en: This is a map of the city of Sendai.
ex.zh: 這是一張仙台市的地圖。

ex.en: A map helps us to know where we are.
ex.zh: 地圖幫助我們知道所在的位置。

ex.en: Can you give me a map of the street?
ex.zh: 請給我一張街道地圖好嗎？

ex.en: He is the manager of the marketing department.
ex.zh: 他是行銷部的經理。

ex.en: Dad said he'd be promoted to section manager next year.
ex.zh: 爸爸說他明年會升為課長。

ex.en: I have to introduce Mary to the manager.
ex.zh: 我得把瑪麗介紹給經理認識。
